map.由转动惯量与角加速度求所需扭矩 使用指南: Required Torque from Moment of Inertia and Angular Acceleration User Guide
map.输入旋转部件转动惯量 I 与目标角加速度 α，工具按 τ=I·α 计算所需驱动扭: Enter the moment of inertia I of the rotating part and the target angular acceleration α, and the tool computes the required drive torque as τ=I·α, for torque budgeting and servo selection on robot rotary joints.
map.输入转动惯量 I 与角加速度 α，求所需扭矩。: Enter the moment of inertia I and the angular acceleration α to get the required torque.
map.填写「转动惯量 I (kg·m²)」。: Enter the moment of inertia I (kg·m²).
map.：I=1 → τ=4 N·m，同角加速需更大力矩。: I=1 → τ=4 N·m, so the same angular acceleration needs more torque.
map.由每转步数求步距角: Step angle from the number of steps per revolution
map.由视差求物体深度: Depth of an object from parallax
map.由位移与速度求运动时间: Find the travel time from displacement and speed
map.τ=Iα 对应 F=ma，I 为转动惯量、α 为角加速度。: τ=Iα is the counterpart of F=ma, where I is the moment of inertia and α the angular acceleration.
map.本式仅加速项；水平臂还需叠加重力矩。: This formula covers the acceleration term only; a horizontal arm must also add the gravitational torque.
